dossier.anchor_quote: nuclear bomb as a pet playstyle — scaling a falcon companion's damage through player critical strikes and penetration buffs

payload_json.note: IDENTITY_MISMATCH: capstone is for Falconer mastery (real class). Falconer is third mastery for Rogue. Mastery bonus: +12 Dexterity, +1 Falcon Melee Damage per 4 Dexterity. Capstone identity described as 'nuclear bomb as a pet' — scales Falcon companion damage through player critical strikes and penetration buffs. Unique mastery skills: Aerial Assault, Dive Bomb (Falconer-exclusive). ZHP (Zero Hit Points) design variant: 'focused entirely on maximizing Damage with no regard for Defense except guaranteed Dodges'. Introduced with Last Epoch 1.0 (February 2024), NOT Season 4.

dossier.anchor_quote: Uniques: Peak of the Mountain, Foot of the Mountain, Apogee of Frozen Light, Death Rattle, Woven Flesh, Melvern's Writ

payload_json.note: IDENTITY_MISMATCH: items are for Explosive Ballista Falconer. Uniques: Peak of the Mountain (bow), Foot of the Mountain, Apogee of Frozen Light, Death Rattle (amulet — crit multiplier), Woven Flesh (chest — crit avoidance conversion), Melvern's Writ, Uethrin's Stand, Phantom Grip, Tyrant's Skull, Mourningfrost, Talons of Valor (bow — primary cooldown enabler). Idols: Large Shadow Idols (Health/Elemental Resistance), Adorned Majasan Idol (Bow Physical Damage). Key passives: Sapping Strikes, Finesse Them, Needle Like Precision, Fencing Grace, Coordinated Fade, Free Lofting Bird, Sky Signal, Handler, Perfect Aim, Shared Enhancements.

dossier.anchor_quote: incredible AoE, Damage capability; Dexterity scaling affects area via Armed Construction multiplier

payload_json.note: IDENTITY_MISMATCH: geometry is for Explosive Ballista Falconer (real 'ballista-and-bird' kit). Explosive Trap: thrown trap, mid-range AoE explosion on trigger. Ballista: stationary turret projectile, auto-targeting ranged. Dive Bomb: Falcon descends on a target location — large AoE per 'amazing AoE' descriptor; AoE scale modified by Hindering Beak Strike passive node. Smoke Bomb: placed cloud AoE (area protection, movement tool). Aerial Assault: leap forward with Falcon carry + Wing Burst at target location. Build achieves 'Screen-Wide AoE' per maxroll guide.

dossier.anchor_quote: Use Explosive Trap to proc Ballista from a safe distance; deploy Dive Bomb and Falcon Strikes against priority targets; time Smoke Bomb defensively

payload_json.note: IDENTITY_MISMATCH: 'Bomb Lance' is not a Last Epoch skill. Real 'ballista-and-bird' build is Explosive Ballista Falconer. Rotation: spam Explosive Trap (0 mana cost) to proc explosive Ballistae; use Dive Bomb for burst against priority targets; Falconry provides passive Falcon Strikes; Smoke Bomb for defense and mobility. All skills: Explosive Trap (primary spam), Ballista (summoned turret, triggered by Explosive Trap via Armed Construction node), Dive Bomb (burst), Falconry (Falcon companion + passive Falcon Strikes), Smoke Bomb (defense/movement).

IDENTITY_MISMATCH: variants are for the Falconer 'ballista-and-bird' archetype. Three main variants: (1) Explosive Ballista Falconer — Explosive Trap procs Ballista (screen-wide AoE, cold/physical, BinaQc); (2) Dive Bomb Falconer — Explosive Trap cools down Falcon Dive Bomb for burst (LizardIRL); (3) Ballista Falconer — Ballista as primary, Aerial Assault buff, ZHP/dodge design (BinaQc). Additional: Bleed Falconer (Net+Puncture+Dive Bomb bleed stacks), Bow Bleed Ballista (fextralife). All confirmed present from 1.0 launch (Feb 2024) through Season 4 (March 2026).
